$comment: Template for Copilot cloud agent MCP configuration. Paste the mcpServers object into your repository's Settings > Copilot > Coding agent > MCP configuration. It contains no secrets. The cloud agent runs on Linux without Power BI Desktop. Power BI Modeling MCP ships a Linux build and can open a PBIP folder, but this lab hasn't verified that on the cloud agent, so it's read-only here and the cloud agent labs don't depend on it.
